name: Digital certificate or Cl@ve for the legal representative
how_to_get: Companies need a representative certificate from the FNMT. Autónomos can use a personal certificate or Cl@ve. Also install AutoFirma to sign.

name: Acelera Pyme digital self-assessment
how_to_get: A short online test on Acelera Pyme. Required before applying for Kit Digital.

name: Authorisation for us to apply for you
how_to_get: Download our template, sign it and upload it. Or grant it online in the government’s REA register (apoderamiento).

name: Kit Digital representative authorisation (Anexo II)
how_to_get: Official Red.es form. Sign it and upload it.

name: Project description with the energy saving (memoria descriptiva)
how_to_get: Lists the equipment you replace, the new models and the saving. Use the Ministry’s official models if available; our template follows the same structure.

name: Project description (memoria del proyecto)
how_to_get: What you will do, why, the budget and the timeline.

name: Business and viability plan with a 3-year profit forecast
how_to_get: Shows your business idea, start-up investment and a profit-and-loss forecast. For Línea 2 every year must show a profit.

name: De minimis aid declaration
how_to_get: Lists any other small state aid received in the last 3 years. Fill in, sign and upload.

name: SME declaration (declaración responsable de PYME)
how_to_get: Confirms your staff numbers and turnover. Fill in, sign and upload.

name: Cámara application forms (anexos de solicitud)
how_to_get: Official forms on the Cámara de Málaga page for this grant. Fill in, sign and upload.

name: ID of the legal representative (DNI or NIE)
how_to_get: A clear photo or scan of both sides.

name: Company deeds and proof of the director’s appointment
how_to_get: Escrituras de constitución and nombramiento de administrador. Your notary or gestor has them.

name: Tax registration certificate (certificado de situación censal)
how_to_get: Free and instant from the Agencia Tributaria e-office. Shows your activity (IAE) and start date.

name: Official document showing your CNAE code
how_to_get: Your last corporate tax return (Modelo 200), or the Social Security “Informe de situación de código de cuenta de cotización”. Must show CNAE 55 or 56.

name: Certificate of being up to date with Hacienda
how_to_get: Agencia Tributaria e-office: “Certificado de estar al corriente de obligaciones tributarias”. Usually instant.

name: Certificate of being up to date with Social Security
how_to_get: Import@ss or the Social Security e-office: “Certificado de estar al corriente”.

name: Bank account ownership certificate (certificado de titularidad)
how_to_get: Download it from your online banking or ask your branch. The account must be in the applicant’s name.

name: Proof of autónomo registration (alta en RETA)
how_to_get: Import@ss: “Informe de situación actual” or your registration resolution.

name: Certificate of registration on the padrón (empadronamiento)
how_to_get: From your town hall, often available online.

name: Qualification certificate (ESO or higher)
how_to_get: Your school or university certificate, or the official title.

name: Proof of last year’s turnover
how_to_get: Last corporate tax return (Modelo 200) or annual VAT summary (Modelo 390).

name: Detailed quote or invoice for the new equipment
how_to_get: From your supplier, showing each model, its energy class and prices without IVA.

name: Proof of the energy saving
how_to_get: EU energy labels of the old and new equipment, or a technician’s comparison report where there is no label.

name: Quotes (presupuestos) for the project
how_to_get: From your suppliers, with prices excluding IVA.

name: Energy certificate of the premises before the works
how_to_get: From a qualified technician (arquitecto or ingeniero).

name: Registro de Turismo de Andalucía registration
how_to_get: Proof your business is in the Andalusian tourism register.

name: Signed full-time employment contract (6 months or more)
how_to_get: Registered through Contrat@, usually by your gestor.

name: Proof the new hire is in Garantía Juvenil and on Talento Joven
how_to_get: The Cámara provides this for candidates on the programme.

name: Proof the new hire is a Talento 45+ participant
how_to_get: The Cámara provides this for candidates on the programme.

name: Paid invoices and bank proof of each payment
how_to_get: Keep every invoice and the bank transfer that paid it. Cash payments usually don’t count.

name: Certificate from an authorised waste manager for the old equipment
how_to_get: Your supplier or installer usually arranges this.

name: Payslips and Social Security payment receipts for the new hire
how_to_get: Your gestor produces these monthly.
